{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_bad = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_bad)}")

# Inspect the sample_seq for duplicates
print(f"Max sample_seq per patient: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().describe()}")"}
